question: Does requiring exact source-letter recovery unnecessarily exclude a concrete useful human note language?
decision: Exact source wording is not a necessary requirement for a declared content language. IDEA000951 already makes that distinction explicitly, so shared-topic instruction factoring is not a new proposal. Retain its positive abstract readability and its separate failed fixed physical realization. No new carrier or statistical experiment is selected.

one_existing_contract.input: An author supplies an ordered sequence of ground instruction/assertion trees in the declared small grammar. Named entities are stipulated in the message domain; the input is not uninterpreted historical prose.
one_existing_contract.readable_content: Topic identity, explicit second participants, action order, property/action distinction, negation, prohibition, conditions and the declared postchecked UNTIL scope.
one_existing_contract.not_recovered: Original spelling, synonyms, voice, and natural-language sentence formulation are not part of this content contract. Unsupported quantities, units, tense, higher arities and unresolved references may not disappear into a new opaque predicate label.
one_existing_contract.written_signals: A quoted @ topic header, quoted open predicate/name strings, typed action heads, parentheses/comma scope and visible group/paragraph boundaries are written in the teaching notation. The fixed syntax is not itself a paid22-working-sign carrier.
reading_procedure: Read the explicit topic header and retain that exact named entity as the first participant.
Parse every following complete predicate/action group with the frozen constructors and quote/escape rules.
Insert the topic only into its declared first-participant position; a written second participant does not silently take over.
Return the ordered content trees, retaining repetitions and scope. Change topic only at an explicit header; clear it at the declared paragraph boundary.

new_manual_demonstration_of_the_existing.provenance: Invented examples, not source excerpts or native word assignments. The two paraphrases are explicitly stipulated to express the same intended plan; no general automatic paraphrase recognizer is claimed.
same_content_inputs: Lege Nara neben Vela. Mache danach Nara fein.
Nara soll zuerst neben Vela gelegt und anschließend fein gemacht werden.

reference_counterpair.different_input: Lege Nara neben Vela. Mache danach Vela fein.
reference_counterpair.reason: The first notation still acts on Nara after the relation. Inferring Vela as the next topic would change the intended content and violate the declared reading rule.

order_counterpair.different_input: Mache Nara fein. Lege Nara danach neben Vela.
order_counterpair.reason: The two action positions are ordered; no commutation is licensed.

method_counterpair.reason: A fine-texture goal does not identify chopping, grinding or sieving. A specified method must be an explicit learned action, not guessed from the goal.

new_manual_demonstration_of_the_existing.learning_cost: The reader must learn the constructors and F=fine-texture, understand the action labels place-beside/chop with their arities, and know what the stipulated names denote. Merely copying an unfamiliar name does not teach its meaning. The full name strings, quotes, controls and scopes all require physical writing.

precise_collision_requirement.criterion: The surface must determine one declared ordered content tree, or an explicitly declared equivalence class of such trees. Distinct original sentences may share a surface only when their supplied intended content is the same under that contract.
precise_collision_requirement.not_a_free_context_license: An unseen participant, omitted method, unmarked scope change or a genuinely unknown predicate cannot be restored solely because a reader can invent a coherent story.
precise_collision_requirement.semantic_equivalence_limit: This review uses identical ordered trees, not arbitrary logical equivalence. It does not silently deduplicate assertions, commute actions or turn repeated properties into intensity/count.

primary_boundaries.consequence: The referent and scope distinctions were already manually positive. This note is an explicit contrast example, not a newly discovered semantic channel.

The later fixed physical realization failed its short-word production capacity. That grammar-level output restriction does not depend on recovering original source spelling; loosening source wording therefore does not reopen that exact carrier. The abstract951 language is not universally refuted.

Those three complete control writers preserve the normalized source words/spelling/punctuation explicitly. That is their chosen input contract, not a proof that every meaningful note language must preserve original FORM. Their original failures remain.

The fitted artificial writer has a complete public inverse for the projected CoReMA sources. This proves a real source-preserving construction and remains stronger than an unimplemented semantic sketch. It does not impose byte recovery on all possible human languages or establish historical practicality. Its later physical-form restrictions remain separate.

Removing lexical/entity identity and keeping anonymous graph structure was already tested and did not meet its calibration gates. Dropping original wording is therefore not permission to drop the participants/actions that carry content.951 instead writes or learns their identities explicitly; this is a different stated representation, not a reopening of those graph results.

statistical_scope: Word-type/frequency invariance requires the relevant fixed source-word-to-output-group assumptions. A declared content compiler can change those units, so the old word-preserving bounds cannot be transferred without that premise. Conversely, naming a content compiler supplies neither a native word-construction prediction nor any frequency PASS. This note selects no such compiler or count.
selection_limit: No new scientific selection follows: the useful semantic allowance already exists in951, and its actual22-sign realization and fully covered source content still require a genuinely changed complete contract. Do not commission another abstract parser or duplicate shared-topic RAW card on the basis of this note.

access_and_ownership.read: Live route, relevant topic/idea/route navigation, the951 raw/reviews and the listed primary methods/reports. No corpus, native transcription query, image, source acquisition, encoder, solver or measurement.

Future structured-result reads must select status/proof/decision fields before output.
